🔥 बॉक्स ऑफिस पर होने वाला है सबसे बड़ा मुकाबला! 🎬

सलमान खान की अपकमिंग फिल्म Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace की रिलीज डेट 4 दिसंबर 2026 पक्की हो गई है। 🇮🇳

डायरेक्टर अपूर्वा लाखिया की ये गलवान वॉर ड्रामा फिल्म सीधे श्रद्धा कपूर की बायोग्राफिकल ड्रामा Eetha से टकराएगी। 💥

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक इस क्लैश से स्क्रीन और शो बंट जाएंगे, जिससे सलमान खान का 2010 से चला आ रहा 18 लगातार फिल्मों का सौ करोड़ क्लब वाला रिकॉर्ड खतरे में पड़ सकता है। 📊

साल 2010 की फिल्म Veer के बाद से सलमान की हर फिल्म ने घरेलू बॉक्स ऑफिस पर 100 करोड़ नेट का आंकड़ा पार किया है। Dabangg से शुरू हुआ यह सिलसिला 18 फिल्मों तक चला है। 🌟

दिनेश विजान की Eetha जहां महाराष्ट्र और वेस्ट इंडिया में मजबूत multiplex visibility रखेगी, वहीं Maatrubhumi नॉर्थ इंडिया के सिंगल स्क्रीन पर कब्जा जमाएगी। 🍿

क्या इस क्लैश के बाद भी सलमान खान अपनी फिल्म को 100 करोड़ के पार ले जा पाएंगे या टूटेगा उनका यह शानदार रिकॉर्ड? 🧐

कमेंट करके अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Box Office: Will Maatrubhumi VS Eetha Clash Lead To Salman Khan Failing This Ultimate Record Streak Of 18 Films?
ctx.summary:
Salman Khan's Maatrubhumi is arriving in the theaters on December 4 to clash with Eetha - will it break his record box office streak? 
 The post  Box Office: Will Maatrubhumi VS Eetha Clash Lead To Salman Khan Failing This Ultimate Record Streak Of 18 Films?  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Superstar Salman Khan is gearing up for his next big-screen spectacle as director Apoorva Lakhia’s Galwan War drama Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace officially locks its theatrical release date for December 4, 2026. However, the announcement has set off intense buzz, creating a high-stakes box office showdown with Shraddha Kapoor’s biographical drama Eetha on the very same day!
While a high-profile December clash always generates high-voltage interest, the film might miss a personal milestone for Salman Khan owing to this intense clash! Ever since 2010, the superstar has built an unbroken legacy at the domestic box office, maintaining a streak of 18 consecutive films crossing the 100 crore net milestone in India!
With screen counts and show allocations set to be divided between Maatrubhumi and Eetha, one critical question stands unanswered for now: Will the clash disrupt Salman Khan’s legendary 18-film streak, or will his stardom carry Maatrubhumi past the 100 crore mark once again, for the 19th time?
The last time a Salman Khan-led vehicle failed to cross the 100 crore net benchmark in India was the 2010 period action drama Veer. Since Dabangg in September 2010, the superstar has delivered 18 consecutive 100 crore+ net grossers, establishing an untouched record in Indian cinema!
With Maatrubhumi clashing with Dinesh Vijan’s Eetha, the two films will face a tight screen split. While Maatrubhumi will command mass single screens across North India, Eetha will hold strong multiplex visibility across Maharashtra, West, and Central India.
Maatrubhumi operates as an intense, emotional war drama based on the Galwan confrontation, appealing to mass action-drama audiences. Eetha features Shraddha Kapoor as the legendary folk artist Vithabai Narayangaonkar, coming right off her historic Stree 2 wave.
Even in a divided release environment, Salman Khan ‘s minimum floor during non-holiday/clash periods has consistently remained above 110 crore , as seen with Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan at 110 crore and Sikandar at 129.95 crore. But this is almost at the border of the 100 crore mark, and with Eetha clashing, it would be a difficult number to touch!
With a box office run that has not dipped below 110 crore net across his last 18 consecutive releases over 16 years, Maatrubhumi needs only a steady mass hold to comfortably extend Salman Khan’s record-shattering streak to 19 consecutive 100 crore films!
